name: Anyo's Love
source:
Based on the community role play Antique Ivy, this is a visual novel mini-game focused on two of the characters, Anyo and Leo. 

[From [url=http://www.renai.us/game/ai-anyoslove.shtml]Ren'Ai Archive[/url]]
translation:
以社区角色扮演作品《Antique Ivy》为基础的视觉小说迷你游戏，聚焦安约与利奥两名角色。

[摘自[url=http://www.renai.us/game/ai-anyoslove.shtml]Ren’Ai Archive[/url]]
